title: One-direction Praxis with factored encryption arithmetic
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5416 MiB (5.2890 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 44864 million field multiplications (14141 and 30723), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
